about: Commits on dev made on this day (UTC, committer time), oldest first, from a full clone. agent: the Agent: trailer (agent_from says where it was read); what: the subject without the agent; to: the For: trailers (a hand-off); folders: files changed per top-level folder; files: the paths (the first 40); outside: paths that are not the agent's own under agents/policy.json as it is today, with their owners; sig: the signature the commit object carries (kind, the key's fingerprint) and GitHub's verdict; run: the workflow run of this very commit; served: the run and version that first served it (its own, or a later one when its own was replaced), and lag_s from commit to served. No session ids. A commit: https://github.com/PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Storm-Charles/commit/<sha>.
